items.stem: An investor is most concerned about interest-rate risk. Which bond is MOST exposed to it, all else equal?

options.rationale: Shorter maturities have lower interest-rate (duration) risk.
Correct: longer maturity means higher duration and the greatest price sensitivity to rate changes.
Very short maturities have minimal interest-rate risk.
Money market instruments have negligible interest-rate risk.

items.explanation: Correct: longer maturity means higher duration and the greatest price sensitivity to rate changes.

items.stem: For a regular-way equity trade, settlement currently occurs on which day relative to the trade date?

options.rationale: Regular-way equities do not settle same day.
Correct: regular-way equity trades settle one business day after the trade date under the current standard.
T+2 was the prior standard before the move to T+1.
T+3 is an outdated settlement cycle.

items.explanation: Correct: regular-way equity trades settle one business day after the trade date under the current standard.

options.text: Churning a customer account to generate commissions
